fixes.explanation: Close, but that's not what Jesus says this person seeks. He says the one who speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory. Then He says the one who seeks the glory of the One who sent Him is “…a man of truth…” (John 7:18). Two different people in one verse, and it's easy to mix them up.
The crowd doesn't say yes. They answer, “You have a demon…” Then they ask, “Who is trying to kill You?” They ask who it could be, and that's all the text gives us.
